_about: The artefact master buff (the owner, 2026-10-26: "collection time -60%", its own bonus changed; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). Artifact-master (artefact_booster, a booster: it works carried) had one default modification, 1134: artefact_search_time_modifier (index 7) -0.25, the strongest roll of that type (drop_weight 4.096), which gear rolls too, so it is not changed. A new modification 1135, made like 1134 with -0.60 and drop_weight 0 (it never rolls), added at the end of the table (after protein-aim-1's 1085), replaces it as the booster's default. The card: "Collection time: -60%" (line 108, lower is better).
